record.name: Lesotho
record.summary: No qualifying institute identified. Lesotho validated a national AI policy in 2025 and adopted it in August 2026; a UN-supported workshop in August 2026 produced a draft national compute roadmap. No AI agency or testing body is named.

partial.scope: Negative-status confidence, preserved query provenance, national/official-language search coverage and source-independence audit; this is not a full recheck of all record fields.

Reassessed negative confidence under the revised rule using saved research. Recorded English and national or official-language queries and retrieved primary governance evidence support medium confidence. No new search or full recheck.
Attempted preservation of cited source copies and checked saved-copy hashes; failures remain in source access notes. This source-evidence work is not a full factual recheck of the record.

searches.query: Lesotho national AI safety institute advanced model evaluation government

check.language_note: English is an official language or an official language of national administration; it is a practical national search language for this check. Other national or official languages were not exhaustively searched. Search source_ids identify registered source URLs matched in the retrieved result set, which may include irrelevant hits. An empty list means no registered source URL was matched, not that the web response was empty. The earlier audit used independent_source_ids for substantive corroboration; governance_source_ids, where present, identifies the selected primary governance evidence.
check.independence_note: Historical audit under the superseded two-independent-sources rule: Two substantively independent evidence origins were not established. Multiple pages from one owner, mirrors, reports of the same underlying announcement and general regional coverage are not counted as independent corroboration.
check.governance_note: The government news agency quotes the minister on the developed and validated national AI policy and its relationship to the continental strategy.

related_bodies.name: Ministry of Information, Communications, Science, Technology and Innovation (MICSTI)
related_bodies.role: It leads the AI policy and the strategy drafting; it owns the policy and is not an evaluation body.

record.notes: Primary sources opened: the national news agency report of the minister's March 2025 statement and the government's September 2026 account of the national compute roadmap. Osiris reports a UN-supported workshop in Maseru from 17 to 21 August 2026.
